healthy.name: Healthy Maize Leaf
healthy.description: The maize leaf shows no visible disease symptoms.
prevention: Ensure proper spacing for air circulation

common_rust.name: Common Rust
common_rust.description: A fungal disease that produces reddish-brown pustules on corn leaves.
symptoms: Pustules usually on lower leaf surfaces first
Premature leaf death in severe cases
management: Reduce plant density for better air circulation
Apply early when pustules are visible
prevention: Monitor fields regularly during susceptible periods

northern_leaf_blight.name: Northern Leaf Blight
northern_leaf_blight.description: A fungal disease causing long, narrow lesions on corn leaves.
symptoms: Tan or gray lesions with dark borders
Progression from lower to upper leaves
Multiple lesions can cause leaf death
northern_leaf_blight.causes: Fungal infection by Setosphaeria turcica (Exserohilum turcicum)
prevention: Space plants for good air circulation

gray_leaf_spot.name: Gray Leaf Spot
gray_leaf_spot.description: A fungal disease causing rectangular gray-brown lesions on corn leaves.
symptoms: Gray or tan center with darker brown borders
Small black dots visible in lesions
management: Reduce plant population for better air circulation
prevention: Monitor fields from V6 growth stage onward
